name: simulasi
description: Sistem Simulasi Nilai dengan penerapan Zero Trust Security (API Gateway sebagai PEP, Policy Engine, Service Nilai, dan Service Transkrip).

scripts.start: node db/seed.js && concurrently -k -n gateway,nilai,transkrip -c blue,cyan,green "node gateway/app.js" "node service-nilai/app.js" "node service-transkrip/app.js"
